title: Better Resource Monitor vs Stats
description: Stats and Better Resource Monitor are both free Mac menu bar monitors. Better Resource Monitor is the simpler, lower-overhead option if you mainly want CPU, memory, GPU, and network at a glance.
heading: Better Resource Monitor vs Stats
intro: Stats and Better Resource Monitor are both good menu bar monitors, but they aim at slightly different people. Stats goes deeper into extra sensors like fans and thermals. Better Resource Monitor takes the simpler route: keep CPU, memory, GPU, and network visible all the time, stay lightweight, and avoid adding extra friction just to keep an eye on your Mac.

sections.heading: What each app is optimized for
sections.body: Stats covers more ground if you care about fan speeds, thermals, and deeper sensor data. Better Resource Monitor is narrower on purpose. It focuses on the four things most people actually check first when their Mac feels off: CPU, memory, GPU, and network usage.

sections.heading: Why Better Resource Monitor stays lighter
sections.body: Better Resource Monitor sits under 0.1% CPU on Apple Silicon and uses about 15 MB of memory. Part of that comes from not chasing every possible sensor. If you mostly want quick visibility instead of a full hardware dashboard, that tradeoff keeps the app easier to leave running all day.

sections.heading: Why the technical choices still matter
sections.body: The no-admin-password, no-root-helper approach is not the main reason to pick Better Resource Monitor, but it does help explain the product. It installs like a normal Mac app, stays sandboxed, and uses public APIs for GPU data. For most people, that just translates to lower friction and fewer surprises.

cta: Stats is still a good pick if you want the broader sensor suite. If your goal is simpler — keep an eye on your Mac, notice unusual load sooner, and keep overhead low — [Better Resource Monitor is on the Mac App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/better-resource-monitor/id6758237306) and the source is on [GitHub](https://github.com/alexx855/better-resource-monitor).
